title: 第5章 几家欢喜几家愁第6章 回家
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
经过两个多月的相处，宁苒苒已经快融入进这个家了，可能是因为宁苒苒的存在，唐昊跟之前天天喝酒的样子不一样了，起码开始打铁赚钱了。
这让宁苒苒很欣慰，这样的话，三哥也算是跟原来剧情不一样了，不再是一个没娘爹不疼的孩子。
“小三，过了年你就开始跟我学打铁吧。”
唐昊夹了块肉递进宁苒苒碗里，开口。
宁苒苒习以为常，她发现别看唐昊表面一副硬汉模样，内心深处其实很喜欢女孩子，如果唐三是个女儿，大概会很幸福，也不会像现在一样，这么惨了。
唐三面色正经，一脸惊喜：“是，爸爸。”
唐昊头也不抬，继续吃饭，尽管这样，唐三已经很开心了。
他又偷偷看了眼宁苒苒，这一切的改变，都是因为宁苒苒的到来。
经过两个多月的相处，唐三早就把宁苒苒当成自己的妹妹了，他在心里暗暗发誓，会永远保护宁苒苒，永远！
而坐在唐三对面的宁苒苒丝毫不知道自己已经被唐三纳进了保护圈，还在开开心心的吃着饭！
宁苒苒：三哥做的饭可真好吃（^o^）～
与此同时，七宝琉璃宗内———
餐厅上四人坐在桌前，却气氛沉闷，本来年夜应该是个欢快温馨的晚上，但是如今因为宁苒苒迟迟不曾找到，而令这个年夜饭索然无味。
宁荣荣：“唉……也不知道苒苒现在怎么样了，有没有饭吃，会不会挨饿受冻，会不会害怕？”
说着眼睛里又盛满泪水，“呜呜……爸爸，这都怪我，我没保护好苒苒……”
“乖，荣荣不哭，放心吧！
爸爸会找到苒苒的！”
宁风致给女儿抹了抹眼泪。
“是啊荣荣，乖，你剑爷爷一定给你把苒苒找回来，不哭了啊！”
剑斗罗心疼的不行。

“不行，我亲自去找，我就不信了，堂堂七宝琉璃宗还找不着一个孩子了？”
骨斗罗突的一声站起来，顾不上吃饭，急匆匆的出去了。
宁风致揉了揉眉心，无奈的叹了口气。
———分割线———
过了年后，唐三和宁苒苒就都六岁了，前几天村长老杰克过来告诉唐三，再过半个月武魂殿的人会过来给他们觉醒武魂，让唐三好好准备。
唐昊一脸无所谓，而唐三却觉得很高兴，最近他的玄天功遇到了瓶颈，正好看看武魂觉醒后会有什么不同。
宁苒苒很烦恼，原因无他，她不想去武魂殿觉醒，且不说她来自七宝琉璃宗，武魂肯定会是七宝琉璃塔，也不知道武魂殿知道了她的身份会做什么反应。
而且，她估计七宝琉璃宗的人应该快找到她了，最晚一个月。
想到到时候她就要离开了，宁苒苒就有些不舍。
经过这么多月的相处，宁苒苒早把唐三当成了自己的亲哥哥。
唐昊依然像之前一样，每天照常教唐三打铁，就这样，日子很快就到了武魂觉醒的日子。
“苒苒，你真的不跟我一起去吗？你跟我一样六岁了，错过今天，还不知道要等多久才有机会觉醒武魂呢！”
唐三皱眉，但是又对宁苒苒无可奈何，宁苒苒：“三哥，你去吧！
我在家等你回来就好。”
“行了，你快去快回，苒苒既然不想去，那就让她在家等你好了。”
唐昊一边打铁一边说。
唐三：……“好吧。
那苒苒你乖乖在家等着，哥哥很快回来！”
content_en:
After more than two months of getting along, Ning Ranran has almost integrated into this family. Perhaps because of Ning Ranran's existence, Tang Hao is no longer the same as before when he drank every day. At least he has started to make money by blacksmithing.
This makes Ning Ranran very happy. In this case, the third brother is different from the original plot. He is no longer a child who has no father and no love.
"Xiaosan, after the Chinese New Year, you can start learning blacksmithing from me."
Tang Hao put a piece of meat into Ning Ranran's bowl and spoke.
Ning Ranran was used to it, and she discovered that despite Tang Hao's tough guy appearance, deep down he actually liked girls. If Tang San were a daughter, she would probably be very happy, and she wouldn't be as miserable as she is now.
Tang San looked serious and surprised: "Yes, Dad."
Tang Hao continued to eat without raising his head. Despite this, Tang San was already very happy.
He secretly glanced at Ning Ranran again. All these changes were due to Ning Ranran's arrival.
After more than two months of getting along, Tang San had long regarded Ning Ranran as his sister. He secretly swore in his heart that he would protect Ning Ranran forever, forever!
Ning Ranran, who was sitting opposite Tang San, had no idea that she had been taken into the protective circle by Tang San, and was still eating happily!
Ning Ranran: The food cooked by third brother is really delicious (^o^)~
At the same time, within the Qibao Glazed Sect——
Four people were sitting at the table in the restaurant, but the atmosphere was dull. It was supposed to be a cheerful and warm night on New Year's Eve, but now because Ning Ranran had not been found, the New Year's Eve dinner was boring.
Ning Rongrong: "Sigh... I don't know how Ran Ran is doing now. Does she have food to eat? Will she be hungry and cold? Will she be scared?"
As he spoke, his eyes filled with tears again, "Oh...Dad, it's all my fault. I didn't protect Ran Ran well..."
"Be good, Rongrong won't cry, don't worry!
Dad will find Ran Ran! "
Ning Fengzhi wiped her daughter's tears.
"Yes Rongrong, be good, your Grandpa Jian will definitely get Ran Ran back for you, don't cry anymore!"
Sword Douluo felt extremely distressed.
"No, I will look for it myself, but I won't believe it. The dignified Qibao Glazed Sect still can't find a child?"
Bone Douluo stood up with a sudden sound, and hurried out without caring about eating.
Ning Fengzhi rubbed his eyebrows and sighed helplessly.
——Separating line————
After the new year, Tang San and Ning Ranran will be six years old. A few days ago, the village elder Jack came over and told Tang San that in half a month the people from the Spirit Hall would come to awaken their spirits so that Tang San could prepare well.
Tang Hao looked indifferent, but Tang San felt very happy. Recently, his Xuantian Kung had encountered a bottleneck, and he wanted to see what would be different after the martial soul awakened.
Ning Ranran was troubled for no other reason than that she didn't want to go to the Spirit Hall to awaken. Not to mention that she was from the Qibao Glazed Sect, the Spirit would definitely be the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda, and she didn't know how the Spirit Hall would react if they knew her identity.
Moreover, she estimated that the people from the Qibao Glazed Sect would find her soon, a month at the latest.
Thinking that she would leave then, Ning Ranran felt a little reluctant to leave.
After so many months of getting along, Ning Ranran had long regarded Tang San as her biological brother.
Tang Hao was still teaching Tang San how to blacksmith every day as before. In this way, the day for the awakening of the martial spirit soon came.
"Ran Ran, are you really not going with me? You are six years old like me. If you miss today, you don't know how long you will have to wait before you have the chance to awaken your martial spirit!"
Tang San frowned, but there was nothing he could do about Ning Ranran. Ning Ranran said, "Third brother, go ahead!
I'll just wait for you to come back at home. "
"Okay, go and come back quickly. Since Ranran doesn't want to go, just let her wait for you at home."
Tang Hao said while blacksmithing.
Tang San: ..."Okay.
Then Ranran, just wait at home. Brother will be back soon! "
